item.description:
Release v5.8.0

Changes since v5.7.6

  • feat: add K3-256K model to Kimi provider
  • feat(ConversationListPlugin): add sticky sort stabilizer to prevent list jumping
  • feat(ConversationManagerPlugin): add lastMessageAt field for conversation list sorting
  • feat(ConversationVerbosityPlugin): support conversation-scoped and global verbosity read/write
  • feat(DatabaseManagerPlugin): open external SQLite files via Finder/Dock
  • feat(LumiKernel,LumiFactory): gate chat-only rail tabs to chat-supporting containers
  • feat(MessageListPlugin): add SuperLog logging to ListV2View
  • feat(MessageListPlugin): add SuperLog logging to MessageListPlugin and ListView
  • feat(MessageListPlugin): add SuperLog logging to V1 views and ViewModels
  • feat(MiniMaxPlugin): add image generation feature with record persistence
  • feat(MiniMaxPlugin): add music generation feature with record persistence
  • feat(NetworkManagerPlugin): add raw/parsed tab for JSON response body
  • feat(ProjectFileBreadcrumbPlugin): add project file breadcrumb navigation plugin
  • feat(RClickPlugin): add New File submenu preview in rail sidebar
  • feat(SettingsPlugin): add official website link to General settings
  • fix: correct providerID on assistant message after streaming
  • fix: Localize menu bar items for Chinese locale
  • fix(ConversationListPlugin): optimistic selection highlight on tap before manager sync
  • fix(ConversationListPlugin): remove markViewed call on conversation selection
  • fix(ConversationTitlePlugin): fence user message so auto title generation never answers it
